```{r}
require(tidyverse)
require(gcplyr)
require(cowplot)
```

```{r}
# Set ggplot theme
old = theme_set(theme_minimal_grid())
```


## Goal
Determine and compare the delay in re-entering growth from -Pi starvation media into phosphate-replete media between the four species we are studying. A time course was conducted so that for each species, samples were taken after they spent different amount of time in the starvation media to evaluate how the length of starvation affects their recovery.

## Data
Growth curves collected on 2025-11-25 and 2025-11-26
```{r}
# using the read_wides() function from gcplyr to read in the data
dat_wide <- bind_rows(
  read_wides(files = "../input/20251125_ScCgPireentry.csv") |>
    # convert time into proper formats
    mutate(Time = time_length(hms(Time), unit = "hour")),
  read_wides(files = "../input/20251126_Kl_Ca_reetnry.csv") |>
    # convert time into proper formats
    mutate(Time = time_length(hms(Time), unit = "hour")),
  .id = "Plate"
)

# Transform our data to be tidy-shaped
dat_tidy <- 
  trans_wide_to_tidy(wides = dat_wide, id_cols = c("Plate", "file", "Time")) %>% 
  #Set up the Well column so they plot in the correct order
  mutate(Well = factor(Well,
                       levels = paste0(rep(LETTERS[1:8], each = 12), 1:12)))


# load plate design
plate_design <- bind_rows(
  read_csv("../input/20251125_plate_layout_Kl_Ca.csv"),
  read_csv("../input/20251126_plate_layout_Sc_Cg.csv"),
  .id = "Plate"
)
```

## Analysis
### EDA
Identify empty wells
```{r}
tmp <- dat_tidy %>%
  group_by(Plate, Well) %>% 
  summarize(Max = max(Measurements, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(isEmpty = Max < 0.12)
print("The following wells are empty:")
filter(tmp, isEmpty) |> pull(Well) |> paste(collapse = ", ")
```

remove empty wells
```{r}
dat_filtered <- left_join(dat_tidy, tmp) %>% 
  filter(!isEmpty)
```

Plotting growth curves for both plates
```{r fig.width=8}
p <- list()
for(i in c("1", "2")){
  p[[i]] <- dat_tidy %>% 
    left_join(tmp) %>% 
    filter(Plate == i) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Measurements)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = isEmpty)) +
    scale_color_manual("Content", values = c("black", "red"),
                       labels = c("Cells", "Empty wells")) +
    facet_wrap(~Well, nrow = 8, ncol = 12) +
    theme_minimal()
}
print(p[[1]]); print(p[[2]])
```
2. Calculate derivatives
```{r}
# use column 6 as the blank since it is in between the two sets of samples
blank_wells <- paste0(LETTERS[1:8], '6')
blank_value <- dat_tidy |> filter(Well %in% empty_wells) |> 
  pull(Measurements) |> mean(na.rm = TRUE)

dat_deriv <- dat_filtered %>% 
  group_by(Well) %>% 
  mutate(
    # plain derivative
    Deriv = calc_deriv(x = Time, y = Measurements, window_width_n = 5),
    percap_deriv = calc_deriv(x = Time, y = Measurements,
                              percapita = TRUE,
                              blank = blank_value,
                              window_width_n = 5,
                              trans_y = "log")
  )

dat_merged <- left_join(meta_info, dat_deriv, by = "Well")
```
